description: This file defines a custom exception class `SystemCheckException` within the OrangeHRM installer namespace, used for handling system check errors related to PHP extensions during the installation process.

classes.name: SystemCheckException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in Exception, providing static methods for specific system check error messages related to PHP extensions.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOExtension
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating that the PDO extension must be enabled.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOMySQLDriver
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating that the pdo_mysql extension must be enabled.
